This compound is identified as a target of several drugs, including AZD3409, 5-imino-4-(3-trifluoromethyl-phenylazo)-5H-pyrazol-3-ylamine, and ({3-[1-(4-Hydroxy-2-oxo-2H-chromen-3-yl)-propyl]-phenylcarbamoyl}-methyl)-carbamic acid tert-butyl ester. These drugs are known to interact with C-C chemokine receptors, indicating that N6-ISOPENTENYL-ADENOSINE-5'-MONOPHOSPHATE may act as a modulator or ligand for these receptors. The high scores across the three paths suggest a strong and reliable association, though the exact mechanism of interaction remains to be elucidated. The evidence supports a potential role for N6-ISOPENTENYL-ADENOSINE-5'-MONOPHOSPHATE in the regulation of C-C chemokine receptor activity, possibly through direct or indirect interactions.
